fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-compound-enabled", "false") == "true" && context.Request.Method != "OPTIONS" && Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-compound-customer"]).Length > 0 && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-ingestor-url", "").Trim().Length > 0)">
            <set-variable name="compoundMeasurements" value="@{
                try {
                    var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    if (body == null) { return "[]"; }

                    /* Each setting is a JSON object or path=name pairs separated by a semicolon. */
                    var raws = new[] {
                        context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-compound-extraction-paths", ""),
                        context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-compound-dimension-paths", "")
                    };
                    var maps = new[] { new JObject(), new JObject() };
                    for (var i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
                        var raw = (raws[i] ?? "").Trim();
                        if (raw.StartsWith("{", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { maps[i] = JObject.Parse(raw); continue; }
                        foreach (var pair in raw.Split(';')) {
                            var idx = pair.LastIndexOf("=");
                            if (idx <= 0) { continue; }
                            var key = pair.Substring(0, idx).Trim();
                            var name = pair.Substring(idx + 1).Trim();
                            if (key.Length > 0 && name.Length > 0) { maps[i][key] = name; }
                        }
                    }

                    var measurements = new JArray();
                    foreach (var kv in maps[0]) {
                        var token = body.SelectToken(kv.Key);
                        if (token != null && (token.Type == JTokenType.Integer || token.Type == JTokenType.Float)) {
                            var val = (double)token;
                            if (val > 0) {
                                var m = new JObject();
                                m["metricName"] = kv.Value.ToString();
                                m["quantity"] = val;
                                foreach (var dk in maps[1]) {
                                    var dimToken = body.SelectToken(dk.Key);
                                    if (dimToken != null && dimToken.Type == JTokenType.String) {
                                        m["dimensionKey"] = dimToken.ToString();
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                measurements.Add(m);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return measurements.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                } catch (Exception) {
                    return "[]";
                }
            }" />

            
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("compoundMeasurements", "[]") != "[]")">
                    
                        @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("aforo-ingestor-url", "").Trim().TrimEnd('/') + "/api/v1/ingest/compound")
                        POST
                        
                            application/json
                        
                        
                            @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-api-key") ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-api-key"]) : "{{aforo-api-key}}")
                        
                        @{
                            var measurements = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("compoundMeasurements");
                            var productType = (context.Variables.ContainsKey("aforo-product-type")
                                ? Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-product-type"]) ?? "" : "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
                            if (productType.Length == 0 || productType == "NONE") { productType = "API"; }
                            var evt = new JObject();
                            evt["correlationId"] = context.RequestId.ToString();
                            evt["customerId"] = Convert.ToString(context.Variables["aforo-compound-customer"]);
                            evt["occurredAt"] = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o");
                            evt["productType"] = productType;
                            evt["measurements"] = JArray.Parse(measurements);
                            evt["metadata"] = new JObject {
                                ["gateway"] = "azure-apim",
                                ["apiId"] = context.Api != null ? context.Api.Id : "",
                                ["operationId"] = context.Operation != null ? context.Operation.Id : "",
                                ["statusCode"] = context.Response.StatusCode.ToString()
                            };
                            return evt.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                        }
